summary: 58-year-old man from Grand Forks, North Dakota became lost hiking Jan 20 and spent an unplanned night in the RMNP backcountry; found Jan 21 in deep snow ~300 yds off the North Longs Peak Trail south of Alberta Falls by two skiers; suffering hypothermia and exposure injuries; evacuated by toboggan litter to Glacier Gorge Trailhead, then ambulance and Flight for Life to University of Colorado Hospital; 15+ personnel with Larimer County SAR assisting the carry-out.
location: ~300 yds off North Longs Peak Trail, south of Alberta Falls
responding_agency: Rocky Mountain National Park Search and Rescue; Larimer County Search and Rescue
notes: Found by chance by two skiers Jan 21. Parent-opened run 585.
